While heading to the airport to pick up Bapuji’s guest, Jethalal stops by his godown to wash his hands after a crow soils his clothes. Unaware he is inside, Natu Kaka locks up the godown from the outside, leaving Jethalal stranded with a dead phone.
Are you ready for the challenge?
We bring to you the best videos from your favorite show Taarak Mehta Ka Ooltah Chashmah. So, get your daily dose of laughter with Jethalal, Taarak Mehta, Daya, Champaklal and their neighbors in Gokuldham Society.
